Love Live Myoko
https://love-live-myoko.com

Love Live Myoko is a locally operated property and accommodation company based in Myoko, Niigata, Japan.

The website provides information about buying property, property management, accommodation management, holiday accommodation and local services for overseas and domestic visitors.

Business Summary

Love Live Myoko specializes in property and accommodation services in the Myoko mountain area. Primary services include:

• Property sales and real estate buyer support
• Foreign buyer support and property transaction guidance
• Comprehensive property management and snow country maintenance
• Accommodation management for holiday rentals and lodges
• Holiday accommodation bookings for domestic and international travelers
• Relocation assistance and local area advice

Geographic Coverage

Services primarily cover the following locations in Niigata Prefecture, Japan:

• Myoko
• Akakura
• Akakura Onsen
• Akakura Kanko
• Ikenotaira
• Suginohara
• Madarao
• Joetsu
• Niigata

The website focuses specifically on real estate and holiday accommodation in the greater Myoko ski resort region.

Accommodation Pages

Individual accommodation pages describe holiday homes, lodges, and vacation rentals managed in Myoko. Each listing page contains detailed facility descriptions, photo galleries, guest occupancy limits, room counts, location details, and direct booking links. All accommodation data is updated and maintained locally.

Property Listings

Individual property listing pages describe real estate currently offered for sale in the Myoko area. Listings are updated regularly as properties are listed, placed under offer, or sold. Each page provides property specifications, photographs, floor areas, prices, and location details where publicly available.

Local Expertise

Love Live Myoko provides guidance based on extensive first-hand local experience in the region. Topics covered include:

• Living and relocating to Myoko
• Buying real estate in Japan as a foreigner
• Holiday home and lodge ownership
• Year-round snow country living and winter preparation
• Property maintenance and seasonal care
• Accommodation operations and guest management
